topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; POL-05 rules of behavior signed at hire and yearly; sanctions process in POL-01
Board audit committee oversees cyber risk and FedRAMP status quarterly and the co-sourced internal audit firm
Security reporting lines: Director of Security to the CTO and the audit committee; roles in POL-01 and the SSP
evidence: Organization chart; POL-01 section 3; P02 section 5

control_description: Hiring checks, awareness training, and role-based training for engineers with government access
gap: Commercial privileged engineers (managed services, DC-1 platform team) have no tracked role-based training; GRC team capacity is stretched (P01 R-039)
remediation: Role-based training for all 214 privileged engineers (POL-05 4.9); two GRC hires

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP; performance goals for directors include POA&M milestones
CMDB, SIEM, and ticketing provide the information controls depend on
gap: CMDB does not tag components by service line, partition, or data role; managed services and DC-3 assets newly in scope are not mapped to the system description
remediation: STD-01 tagging; system description inventory for the expanded scope (POAM-008)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; security updates to staff monthly; responsibilities in POL-01 to POL-05
MSA, agency terms, and the bank addendum state security commitments and notice duties; status page for customers
gap: Bank designated contacts verified for 31 of 38 banks; customer notice matrix only issued with P08 on 2026-10-01
remediation: Verify all bank contacts; customer notice templates (POAM-019)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk appetite and objectives approved by the CEO; service commitments in the MSA
Annual risk assessment per NIST SP 800-30 with enterprise and system registers
Insider risks (R-009, R-010) and support social engineering (R-047) in the register
gap: Fraud scenarios for billing and metering manipulation and misuse of the RMM tool for profit are not assessed explicitly
remediation: Add fraud scenarios to the 2027 risk assessment with the CFO

control_description: Change advisory board evaluates security impact and FedRAMP significant change for every production change
Annual internal audit assessment (P07) and annual FedRAMP independent assessment; monthly continuous monitoring
evidence: P07 plan and results; 2026-03 FedRAMP assessment

control_description: POA&M reported to the CTO monthly and the audit committee quarterly

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the FedRAMP Rev5 Class C list for both partitions and mapped to risks
General IT controls over identity, change, operations, and backups
gap: Two-speed security: government-partition controls are not yet applied to the commercial partition, managed services, and DC-1
remediation: Close the High POA&M items before the observation period (POAM-002 to POAM-006)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 to POL-05 and standards issued 2026-10-01; procedures under each standard

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider with hardware keys; PAM with just-in-time elevation; network segmentation; encryption
evidence: IdP and PAM configuration; P07 IA-2, AC-6
gap: Managed services (now in scope) uses 2 shared RMM super-administrator accounts; DC-1 clusters A and B use a shared local account without MFA; standing commercial privilege
remediation: POAM-020 and POAM-002 closed and operating before 2027-01-01; just-in-time elevation everywhere (POAM-003)

control_description: Accounts created from HR records and approved by managers; terminations disable the identity provider the same day
gap: Prior SOC 2 exception (2 of 25 late removals) recurred in the P07 sample for DC-1 local accounts
remediation: Termination checklist for DC-1 local accounts until federation (POAM-001)

control_description: Role-based access in the portal, control plane, cloud, and hypervisor managers; quarterly reviews in the government partition
gap: Commercial privileged access reviewed semiannually; 6 of 22 deploy rights unneeded; standing privilege
remediation: Quarterly reviews for both partitions; just-in-time elevation (POAM-001, POAM-003)

control_description: Colocation providers control facilities at DC-1, DC-2, and DC-3; company cages on badge and lock with quarterly list reviews
evidence: Colocation SOC 2 reports; cage access reviews; P07 PE-3
gap: DC-3 newly in scope: its provider's report has not been reviewed for this examination; DC-1 override key not rekeyed
remediation: Review the DC-3 provider report (VEN-03); rekey DC-1 (POAM-011)

control_description: Drives cryptographically erased and destroyed by a certified vendor; customer data deleted 30 days after contract end
gap: DC-1 certificates could not be matched to 3 of 20 sampled serial numbers
remediation: Serial-level certificates at every site

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Boundary firewalls, DDoS scrubbing, web application firewall, PAM bastions
gap: The NOC network reaches DC-1 management interfaces for clusters A and B
remediation: Deny by default (POAM-014)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher for all external and internal transmission; removable media blocked
evidence: TLS scan (P07 SC-8 satisfied); device control policy

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on managed endpoints and servers; software allowlisting on bastions and runners; signed templates in the government partition
evidence: EDR reports (P07 SI-3 satisfied); P07 SI-7
gap: Commercial VM templates are not verified at deployment; commercial signing key in a pipeline secret
remediation: HSM signing and deployment verification (POAM-015)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Authenticated scanning, drift detection, and KEV tracking
evidence: Scan reports; P07 RA-5 and CM-6
gap: Commercial clusters scanned quarterly; KEV tracking manual; DC-1 drift checked monthly
remediation: Monthly scanning and automated KEV due dates from 2026-11-15 (POAM-012, POAM-007)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: SIEM with MDR 24x7 triage and AI-assisted alert triage
evidence: SIEM source list; case export; P07 AU-6
gap: RMM tool (managed services, now in scope) and DC-1 clusters A and B not monitored; AI triage auto-closes 68% of commercial alerts without review
remediation: Onboard sources; limit auto-close; weekly sampling (POAM-005, POAM-006)

control_description: SOC evaluates alerts and declares incidents with the MDR partner
gap: Auto-closed alerts are not evaluated by a person; severity model differs between partitions
remediation: P10 AI-001 conditions; one severity model (POAM-010)

control_description: Incident response under POL-03 and the P08 runbooks, with customer, bank, and agency notices
gap: Runbooks approved 2026-10-01 but not yet exercised

control_description: Recovery runbooks and immutable backups for the control plane
gap: Commercial control plane restore took 9 hours against a 4-hour RTO
remediation: Quarterly commercial restore tests (POAM-009)

control_description: Pipeline-only deployment with two approvers; change advisory board; infrastructure as code
evidence: Change tickets; branch protection; P07 CM-5
gap: A forgotten deploy token could change production outside the pipeline (found and revoked in P07); machine credentials not inventoried
remediation: Machine credential inventory and 90-day expiry (POAM-004)

control_description: Business continuity: BIA, contingency plans, cyber insurance
gap: No contingency plan for the commercial partition or DC-1
remediation: One contingency plan with the DC-1 site-loss runbook (POAM-022)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor tiering and annual Tier 1 reviews; contract security terms
gap: 5 of 14 Tier 1 reviews overdue; RMM vendor exceptions not followed up; 4 Tier 1 contracts lack incident notice terms
remediation: Complete reviews and follow-up by 2026-11-30; amendments by 2027-03-31 (POAM-013)

control_description: Capacity monitoring per cluster with the forecasting model (AI-004); N+1 hosts
gap: DC-2 and DC-3 cannot absorb all DC-1 workloads after a site loss; the forecasting model is not validated (P10)
remediation: Capacity plan for DC-1 failover; quarterly back-testing of the model

control_description: Colocation environmental controls (inherited); immutable backups at DC-2 and DC-3 and in the cloud backup account
control_owner: Director of Backup and DR Services
evidence: Colocation SOC 2 reports; backup reports (P07 CP-9(1) satisfied)

control_description: Restore and failover tests
control_owner: Director of Backup and DR Services
gap: One quarterly restore test for a backup service region was skipped in the last SOC 2 period; commercial control plane test failed its RTO; DC-1 failover never tested
remediation: Quarterly tests for every backup region and both partitions; DC-1 exercise (POAM-009)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: POL-04 classification levels; customer data identified per service; NDA and confidentiality clause in the MSA
gap: Confidentiality is a new category: customer data locations in shared systems (tickets, backup catalogs) not mapped; about 9,000 older commercial volumes unencrypted
remediation: Data location map; encryption of remaining volumes (POAM-017)

control_description: Customer data deleted 30 days after contract end; backup copies expire with retention; drives destroyed
control_owner: Director of Backup and DR Services
gap: Write-once backup copies outlive the 30-day deletion commitment for some retention settings; no customer-facing statement
remediation: Clarify the deletion commitment for backups in the MSA and system description

control_description: Backup service descriptions state job schedules, retention, and restore objectives
control_owner: Director of Backup and DR Services
gap: Processing Integrity is new: objectives are in marketing descriptions, not in the system description with measurable targets
remediation: Write processing objectives into the system description

control_description: Backup selection policies set by customers in the portal and validated by the backup software
control_owner: Director of Backup and DR Services
gap: No check that customer selection policies cover all servers the customer intended (missed servers found in 4 restore requests in 2026)
remediation: Monthly coverage report to each customer

control_description: Backup jobs monitored for completion and errors; failures alert the backup team and the customer
control_owner: Director of Backup and DR Services

control_description: Restores verified by checksum and customer confirmation
control_owner: Director of Backup and DR Services
gap: Restore verification depends on the customer; one quarterly region test was skipped
remediation: Automated restore verification sample each month

control_description: Immutable object storage with replica catalogs at DC-2 and DC-3; integrity checks on stored data
control_owner: Director of Backup and DR Services
